newsitem.title: INDIA: India I-Sec's debt market portfolio watch list.
newsitem.headline: India I-Sec's debt market portfolio watch list.

text.p: ICICI Securities and Finance Company (I-Sec) said it placed the following securities in its "portfolio watch" representing stocks that are likely to outperform the market.
Security Residual Modified Net Price Yield Weightage

The recommended portfolio is heavily weighted in favour of long maturity securities. The cut-off at the seven year gilt auction is likely to be lower than the cut-off at the previous five year issue (12.69 percent), and this will result in strong buying interest at the long end as the yield curve re-aligns itself. It has been assumed that the new security is purchased at ten paise premium to par value either in primary or in the secondary market, irrespective of the cut-off yield.
Ideally, the above securities should be purchased over the fortnight on price reactions, and, performance of this portfolio should be evaluated over one months time frame.
